configurations.name: dev
runtimeArgs: . scripts/dev-ports.sh; if lsof -ti:$DEV_FRONTEND_PORT >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Dev server already listening — attaching to it.'; exec tail -f /dev/null; else echo 'No dev server for this checkout — starting the full dev environment (scripts/dev-pre-launch.sh).'; exec bash scripts/dev-pre-launch.sh; fi
